lines.zh: 我挪动的时候，菌盖跟着晃。
lines.en: When I shift, the cap sways with me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地走，像一丛长腿的菌。
lines.en: I move slowly, like a walking clump of fungus.
Beneath my cap I show only a sliver.

lines.zh: 我从菌丛边上走过，分不出来。
lines.en: I pass a patch of fungus and can't be told apart.
I shift toward where there's warmth.
Mycelium follows me through the soil.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖下面，什么都不露。
lines.en: Nothing shows beneath my cap.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪到阴影里。
lines.en: I shift step by step into the shade.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，像一株老的。
lines.en: I keep low, like an old growth.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，菌会冒出来。
lines.en: Fungus sprouts where I've passed.
I crouch among the fungus without moving.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖上有斑，像腐烂。
lines.en: There are spots on my cap, like rot.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬上来，我让它爬。
lines.en: A bug climbs on me. I let it.
I'm waiting for something to come close.
The mycelium reaches slowly through the soil.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖跟着步子晃，像丛长腿的菌。
lines.en: My cap sways with my steps, a walking clump of fungus.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，也是孢子。
lines.en: I breathe out, and it's spores too.
I'm counting the footsteps coming in.
Two? Or a group?
I lift myself a little.
Then I sink back down.
I count the footsteps coming closer.
Something drips from the cap's edge.
A small patch of ground blackens.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿从土里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull one leg out of the soil.
I push it back into the soil.
You're walking too close to the fungus.
One of those clumps is me.
You haven't worked it out.

lines.zh: 其中有一丛是我，你还没看出来。
lines.en: One of those clusters is me, and you have not noticed.
You're crouching. That's good.
My cap is wider than you.
You're reaching out to pick it.
Reach out and pick it.
I'll wait for you to touch.

lines.zh: 孢子已经在你衣服上了。
lines.en: The spores are on your clothes already.
I pose as a mushroom and wait for your hand.
Now you'll start to feel warm.
A piece of my cap is gone.
It fell to the ground and it's still growing.
I can't retreat from that.
My roots are too deep.
I slowly draw myself in.
Spores scatter everywhere.
You can smell them, can't you.
They're already inside.
There's still me in the mycelium.
I've always been in this patch.
What's in your hand smells of wood.
I don't need to eat it. I want it to rot.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，菌丝想要。
lines.en: My mycelium wants what is in your hands.
The mycelium will find it.
Look. It's starting to blacken.

lines.zh: 再过一会儿，就全是我的。
lines.en: A little longer and it's all mine.
Keep your hands back.
Mycelium climbs hands too.

lines.zh: 它落地的地方，草开始黑。
lines.en: Where it lands, the grass begins to blacken.
I never chase after people.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞一棵烂树。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a rotten stump.
Half my cap has come off.
It'll grow on the ground.
That didn't hurt you, did it.
I step back. It's hard.
My legs aren't good at retreating.
One kick shoves me half a foot.
My cap rights itself slowly.
I've stood on this patch too long.
The roots have gone down.
I've no need of a partner.
I only need wet soil.
The mycelium spreads on its own.
Wherever it spreads, there I am.
I'm not one thing.
I'm this whole patch.

lines.zh: 你踩在哪儿，都是踩在我身上。
lines.en: Wherever you stand, you're standing on me.

lines.zh: 所以你走的时候，轻一点。
lines.en: So be gentle when you leave.

lines.zh: 你踩的每一下我都听得见。
lines.en: I hear every step you take.
I've been listening all along.
I wrap my stalk around it.
My stalk tightens slowly.
It's starting to soften.
Mycelium burrows in from below.
In a while there'll only be a shell.
I eat the shell too.
There'll be a stain on the ground.
Other fungus will grow from it.
I've got this patch watched.
Anyone who comes is the same.
Footsteps on leaves.
I turn my cap slowly toward it.
It takes me for an old patch of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 它把我当成一丛普通的菌。
lines.en: It took me for an ordinary clump.
I press myself lower.

lines.zh: 现在我和别的菌一样高。
lines.en: Now I'm the same height as the others.
It comes up beside me.
It bends to look at another clump.
It's looking at a different clump.
My cap tilts toward it.
My arm lifts, very slowly.

lines.zh: 它还没发现，蘑菇盖还没张开。
lines.en: It has not noticed; my cap is still closed.

lines.zh: 它的脚离孢子圈只差一步。
lines.en: Its foot is one step from the spore ring.
My stalk has made contact.

lines.zh: 它的靴子碰到我的菌柄。
lines.en: Its boot brushes my stem.
I don't let go at all.
The mycelium has already started.
The mycelium grows fast.
I pose as a mushroom; don't pick me.
Not fast. Fungus doesn't run.
It takes a few steps and looks back.
I stand there, like a clump of fungus.
It turns and walks away.
I shift a little more.
My roots pull up soil.
There's a dragging sound in the soil.
It looks back again.
I hold still a long time.
It walks slowly away.
I crouch in the fungus and wait.
It'll come back.
People always do.
I can wait. This whole patch is mine.
The mycelium spreads through the soil.
A foot more every day.

lines.zh: 你出林子就会踩到菌丝。
lines.en: You'll tread my mycelium before you leave.
Then you'll know.
I keep to this patch.
I catch it and my stalk tightens.
Mycelium wraps around its calves.
It chokes and starts coughing.
It tries to pull free and can't.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手也上来了。
lines.en: My other arm comes up too.
It's pressed into the soil.
The soil beneath is all mycelium.
It climbs upward.
Its legs are already inside.

lines.zh: 菌柄一点点把我撑起来。
lines.en: My stalk pushes me up inch by inch.
My cap spreads.
I don't look at what's underneath.
I crouch back among the fungus.
Crouched, waiting for the next.

lines.zh: 我从一片烂木头下面冒出来。
lines.en: I push up from under a rotted log.
Damp here. Just right.
My cap opens slowly.
There's already a ring of fungus around me.
Every clump around is me.
The mycelium in the soil is moving too.
I try to stand.
I can just about stand.
Walking about isn't so easy.
I'll wait here first.
I'll wait here for someone.
Until someone crouches down.
Until someone reaches out.
Then it'll be different.
Water drips from the trees.
Onto my cap.

lines.zh: 我把水一点点吸进菌丝。
lines.en: I draw the water into my mycelium.
I can stay here a long time.
I intend to.
Don't be in a hurry to leave either.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的菌盖缩起来了。
lines.en: Fire makes my cap shrink inward.

lines.zh: 我从土堆上滚下，菌柄断了。
lines.en: I roll off the mound and my stalk snaps.
Water soaks me and I come apart in it.

lines.zh: 炸响把我打散，菌丝还在。
lines.en: The blast scatters me. The mycelium remains.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过菌盖，穿了两个洞。
lines.en: An arrow punches two holes through my cap.

lines.zh: 一道光把孢子烧干净了。
lines.en: A light burns the spores clean.

lines.zh: 土干了，我什么都吸不到。
lines.en: The soil has dried and I can draw nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打在菌盖上，整片林子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my cap and the whole wood lights up.
There's no soil here.
